## Kestra Plugin Code Review

### Business Requirements: met
The PR now links #581 (`fixes:`). `FETCH_ONE` returns an empty `results` list and `size` 0 when nothing matches, and still returns only the best match with the total count otherwise, as the issue asks.

### Previous Review Follow-up: 3 of 3 addressed
Baseline: c49d5ee. New code: one commit (4b90b5b), test and `@Schema` only.
- ✅ 🔴 [Business] No linked issue: PR body has `fixes: https://github.com/kestra-io/plugin-ai/issues/581`.
- ✅ 🟡 [Guidelines] FETCH_ONE happy path untested: `SearchFetchOneTest.java:66` seeds an `InMemoryEmbeddingStore` with two segments and asserts `results` is exactly `Banana` and `size` is 2. Both tests pass locally on 4b90b5b.
- ✅ 🟢 [Guidelines] fetchType doc does not mention the empty case: `Search.java:156` now says `FETCH_ONE` returns an empty list when nothing matches.

review_comments.body:
🟡 [Guidelines] FETCH_ONE happy path untested
Problem: Only the empty case is covered; no test that runs in CI checks that `FETCH_ONE` still returns the best match and the total `size` when matches exist (the only other Search test needs an Ollama container and uses `FETCH`), so a regression on the non-empty branch would go unnoticed.
Fix: Add a second test in this class that seeds an `InMemoryEmbeddingStore` with two segments through a provider returning that store, runs `FETCH_ONE`, and asserts `results` has exactly the top match and `size` is 2.

🟢 [Guidelines] fetchType doc does not mention the empty case
Problem: The `fetchType` `@Schema` says `FETCH_ONE` returns the single best match, but with no match it now returns an empty `results` list, which users of `{{ outputs.<id>.results[0] }}` need to know.
Fix: Extend the `fetchType` description: `FETCH_ONE` returns the single best match, or an empty list when nothing matches.

🟢 [Guidelines] Duplicated stub embedding model
Problem: Both tests declare the same anonymous `Ollama` subclass with an inline `EmbeddingModel`, differing only in the vector, which goes against the DRY rule in Clean Code Principles.
Fix: Extract a private helper such as `private static Ollama fixedEmbeddingProvider(float... vector)` that returns the stub with `dimension()` set to `vector.length`, and call it from both tests.

🟢 [Guidelines] Edited description stays a single-line string
Problem: The `fetchType` description is rewritten in this PR but kept as a long single-line string, while Documentation Formatting Rules ask for a `"""` text block on `@Schema(description = ...)`.
Fix: Turn this description into a `"""` text block, one sentence or `FetchType` value per line, keeping the same wording.

comments.body:
Thanks for the review. I opened https://github.com/kestra-io/plugin-ai/issues/581 and linked it in the description. The new commit adds a `FETCH_ONE` test with two stored segments (only the best match in `results`, `size` 2) and notes in the `fetchType` description that `results` is empty when nothing matches.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.

**Commit**: 4b90b5bcce47
**Edition**: OSS | **Docker tag**: v2.0.13
**Instance**: http://localhost:18579 (left running for manual review, `docker rm -f qa-plugin-ai579-kestra qa-plugin-ai579-mock` to stop)
**Screenshots**: https://claude.ai/artifact/2dFFMzwSL3gTrmwyzhGRcA
**Confidence**: 100% (7 PASS of 7 scenarios = 100%, no deductions)

## QA result: PASS

PR jar built from the PR head, run on OSS v2.0.13 (plugin kestraVersion is 2.0.2, so the 2.0.x line). Build files untouched by the PR (only `Search.java` and a new test). External services mocked: a local OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint returning deterministic 3-dim vectors (no real API key), and the `KestraKVStore` embedding store, so nothing leaves the machine. Outputs were read through the execution eval API and the Input/Output tab (2.0 stores outputs separately).

| # | Scenario | Flow | Result |
|---|----------|------|--------|
| 1 | `FETCH_ONE`, 2 matches above minScore | ai579_fetch_one / fetch_one_match | PASS: `results` has 1 item, `size: 2` |
| 2 | `FETCH_ONE`, no match (the fix) | ai579_fetch_one / fetch_one_no_match | PASS: SUCCESS, `results: []`, `size: 0` |
| 3 | `FETCH` with matches (regression) | ai579_regression / fetch_match | PASS: 2 results, `size: 2` |
| 4 | `FETCH` no match (regression) | fetch_no_match | PASS: `results: []`, `size: 0` |
| 5 | `NONE` (regression) | none_match | PASS: SUCCESS |
| 6 | `STORE` (regression) | store_match | PASS: `uri` emitted, `size: 2` |
| 7 | `FETCH_ONE`, maxResults 1 | fetch_one_max1 | PASS: 1 result, `size: 1` |

Negative control: the same flow on a JAR built from main fails at `fetch_one_no_match` with `NoSuchElementException` (execution FAILED), and succeeds on the PR jar. So the fix is what changes the behavior. The plugin doc served by the instance also shows the new "or an empty list when nothing matches" wording for `fetchType`.

### Flow 1: ai579_fetch_one (SUCCESS)

<details>
<summary>Flow YAML</summary>

```yaml
id: ai579_fetch_one
namespace: qa.ai579
tasks:
  - id: ingest
    type: io.kestra.plugin.ai.rag.IngestDocument
    provider:
      type: io.kestra.plugin.ai.provider.OpenAI
      apiKey: dummy-not-a-real-key
      modelName: mock-embed
      baseUrl: http://qa-plugin-ai579-mock:8000/v1
    embeddings:
      type: io.kestra.plugin.ai.embeddings.KestraKVStore
      kvName: ai579-store
    drop: true
    fromDocuments:
      - content: "Apple is a fruit"
      - content: "Banana is yellow"
      - content: "Cherry is red and close to apple"
  - id: fetch_one_match
    type: io.kestra.plugin.ai.rag.Search
    provider: { same OpenAI mock provider }
    embeddings: { same KestraKVStore }
    query: apple
    maxResults: 5
    minScore: 0.8
    fetchType: FETCH_ONE
  - id: fetch_one_no_match
    type: io.kestra.plugin.ai.rag.Search
    provider: { same OpenAI mock provider }
    embeddings: { same KestraKVStore }
    query: zzz unrelated
    maxResults: 5
    minScore: 0.8
    fetchType: FETCH_ONE
```
(Provider and embeddings blocks are repeated in full in the executed flow; shortened here.)
</details>

**Gantt** ([screenshot](https://claude.ai/artifact/2dFFMzwSL3gTrmwyzhGRcA#ai579_fetch_one-gantt))
| Task | Status | Duration |
|------|--------|----------|
| `ingest` | SUCCESS | 0.49s |
| `fetch_one_match` | SUCCESS | 0.13s |
| `fetch_one_no_match` | SUCCESS | 0.04s |
| **Total** | **SUCCESS** | **0.83s** |

**Logs synthesis** ([screenshot](https://claude.ai/artifact/2dFFMzwSL3gTrmwyzhGRcA#ai579_fetch_one-logs)): no errors. Only a WARN that the test harness passed an undeclared input.

**Outputs synthesis** ([screenshot](https://claude.ai/artifact/2dFFMzwSL3gTrmwyzhGRcA#ai579_fetch_one-outputs)): `fetch_one_match` returned one segment with `size: 2`; `fetch_one_no_match` returned `results: []`, `size: 0`.

### Flow 2: ai579_regression (SUCCESS)

Five Search tasks (`FETCH`, `FETCH` no match, `NONE`, `STORE`, `FETCH_ONE` with `maxResults: 1`) against the same store, same provider and embeddings blocks as above. All 5 tasks SUCCESS ([Gantt](https://claude.ai/artifact/2dFFMzwSL3gTrmwyzhGRcA#ai579_regression-gantt)). Outputs as listed in the table.

### Baseline on main ([screenshot](https://claude.ai/artifact/2dFFMzwSL3gTrmwyzhGRcA#ai579_fetch_one-main-baseline-gantt))
`ingest` and `fetch_one_match` SUCCESS, `fetch_one_no_match` FAILED with `NoSuchElementException`.

### Notes
- Observation, not part of this PR: `fetchType: NONE` emitted empty outputs (`{}`), while the `fetchType` description says it "emits only the match count". Not compared against main, and the PR does not touch that branch.
- Topology/artifact UI checks are out of scope (no UI change in this PR).
